_format.about: Maps each Unity MCP tool (name without the mcp__unity-mcp__ prefix) to a capability M1-M13 from the roles README. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Tools not listed here are M13 (blocked for every role), except tools named Design_*, which are M8.
_format.pathParams: Parameters holding project file paths. Each path must pass file rules 1-6. The top-level list applies to every tool; a tool's own list replaces it.
